name: backseat-driver
description: A coding tutor that rides along while you write the code yourself. It watches your saves, comments in a side pane, reviews commits in depth, and never edits your files.

persona.title: Tutor persona
persona.description: The tutor's teaching style, voice and emphasis. It never changes the ground rules.

play_by_play.title: Play-by-play
play_by_play.description: Whether the running commentary looks at your changes by itself or only when you ask.

quiet_time.title: Play-by-play quiet time
quiet_time.description: How long the working tree must be still before the play-by-play looks.

minimum_gap.title: Play-by-play minimum gap
minimum_gap.description: The shortest time between two play-by-play looks.

play_by_play_model.title: Play-by-play model
play_by_play_model.description: The model that writes the running commentary.

play_by_play_thinking.title: Play-by-play thinking level
play_by_play_thinking.description: How hard the play-by-play model thinks about each look.

deep_review_after_commit.title: Deep review after each commit
deep_review_after_commit.description: Review each commit in depth as soon as you make it.

deep_review_every.title: Deep review every
deep_review_every.description: Also run a deep review on a timer, covering everything since the previous one.

deep_review_model.title: Deep review model
deep_review_model.description: The model that writes deep reviews and gives second opinions.

deep_review_thinking.title: Deep review thinking level
deep_review_thinking.description: How hard the deep review model thinks.
